thread:
maria_cs: FYI incoming escalated ticket from Acme — trial credits ended up on a staging clone after their SSO sync. Customer can't find credits on the main org.
lina_billing: Ugh. Do we have the org_id and workspace_id for both the main and the clone? Need IDs to check the grants.
maria_cs: Yep. main_org: org_01A7X, main_ws: ws_9b3f. clone_org: org_01A7X-clone (auto-created), clone_ws: ws_9b3f-stg. Ticket includes SAML provisioning events.
ryan_platform: Could be the SCIM provisioning creating a secondary workspace during JIT. Sam — any insight from the SSO side? @sam_ops
sam_ops: saw a JIT create for that user at 2026-03-05T14:12Z. sso-bot posted the event: "user_provisioned -> created workspace ws_9b3f-stg for org org_01A7X-clone". Likely the customer has an old duplicated org record in our DB.
lina_billing: If credits were issued to the clone org_id, we can reassign them, but need approval + audit entry. Can you paste the grant_id from the billing UI?
maria_cs: Grant id from their invoice: grant_20260305_77a
ryan_platform: I'll run a lookup. Internal command: org-lookup --grant grant_20260305_77a -> shows recipient_org=org_01A7X-clone, workspace=ws_9b3f-stg
sam_ops: Repro steps for future: have SSO-enabled customer invite user -> enable JIT provisioning -> duplicate org exists with similar name -> credits applied to the newly created org when backend matched email domain.
maria_cs: Customer asked for immediate fix. Lina — can billing move credits back to org_01A7X? They lost access to staging and need to apply to prod.
lina_billing: Yes, we can do manual reassign. I'll need: 1) approval from customer rep in ticket (they sent an admin email), 2) expected credit amount, 3) note in billing audit. I'll do the reassignment and attach audit id here.
ryan_platform: To avoid recurrence, I'll add a check in grant pipeline: if org name similarity > 0.9 and there already exists an org with matching verified domain, block auto-attach and flag for manual review. POC query I ran:
```
SELECT org_id, domain, created_at FROM orgs WHERE domain = 'acme.com' ORDER BY created_at;
```
sso-bot: [automation] scim-event logged: user_create -> ws_9b3f-stg (2026-03-05T14:12:02Z)
maria_cs: Customer replied with OK to proceed yesterday. Thanks all. Lina — any audit id?
lina_billing: audit_98765 recorded. Credits moved: 5000 token-credits from org_01A7X-clone -> org_01A7X. Notified customer. Marking ticket resolved. :white_check_mark:
maria_cs: Awesome. Follow-up: Ryan — can you add the manual-review flag to the grant service? We had a near-miss with another account.
ryan_platform: Yep will open a small RFC and a canary rule this week. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
